Easter at Mynt — Taj West End, Bengaluru (2018).

Seasonal posters for the Mynt Easter brunch, the same offer dressed three pastel ways: a floral wreath and a golden egg; an "egg-cellent" basket in soft purples; a carton of hand-lettered eggs. Spring colour, hand-lettered headlines, premium calm.

F&B campaign design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·54.
